conventions: יָסַד in every stem (Pual 3.6, Piel 3.10, Hophal 3.11, Qal infinitive construct 3.12) is rendered by the ASV as 'the foundation ... was laid' or 'laid the foundation'; the whole phrase, including the supplied 'the', belongs to the verb's one discontinuous unit headed on 'foundation' (rule 44, light verb plus the complement carrying the lexeme), and the Hebrew subject or object noun the recasting demotes (הֵיכַל, בַּיִת) takes the 'of' the ASV writes before it under rule 33, with its own supplied 'the' under rule 29. The 'yet' of 3.6 'was not yet laid' is added; the competing 'not yet' on לֹא was noted and not taken.

כַּכָּתוּב → 'as it is written' (3.2, 3.4): the assimilated article on the passive participle takes the supplied 'it' under rule 41 as the substantival article's pronoun, and the participle keeps 'is written' with its copula under rule 20; the competing reading that marks 'it' added as an impersonal dummy was noted in both verses and not taken.
report: Checked all 35 cross-verse candidate groups; every within-bucket difference is licensed by what the ASV wrote (a 'the', a relative, a pronoun, a connective, or nothing) and none is a construction analysed two ways.

Read the ten added units end to end against the rest of the chapter: 'even' (3.3), 'offered'/'as'/'required' (3.4), 'the offerings' (3.5), 'yet' (3.6), 'with' x2 (3.9), 'their' (3.10), 'saying' (3.11) each answer to no morpheme and no verse folds a comparable word into a neighbour.

All four forms of יסד (3.6 Pual, 3.10 Piel, 3.11 Hophal, 3.12 Qal inf.) are read alike: the ASV's 'the foundation ... was laid' / 'laid the foundation' goes whole to the verb headed on 'foundation' (rule 44) and the demoted subject/object noun takes the recast 'of' (rule 33).

Multi-level construct chains counted consistently under rule 29: בית/איש האלהים (3.2, 3.8, 3.9), חג הסכות (3.4) and קול תרועת השמחה (3.13) front the rectum's article one level; עמי הארצות (3.3) and קול בכי העם (3.13) are arthrous and nothing is fronted.

BSB disagreements (20) are all documented convention differences: unrendered agreement/assimilated articles, two apodosis waws the ASV opens bare, prepositions the ASV spent no word on, and repeated/resumed morphemes rendered once. No genuine error.
No promotion or amendment: the chapter's judgments are all applications of rules already in the contract.
